[sub][i]Response to Dhor Tyranny[/i][/sub]]

Actions of the Dhor Dictatorial State are unacceptable, foreign suppression of the Worldwide Revolution of the Proletariats is a foolish endeavour, which has stirred the Technate to act. With all haste, the Stuipendian People's Cybersecurity Forces go into action. Under the direction of the Chairman of Cyberdefence, with assent from the Chairman of the Defence Forces, they went on the attack. The opening salvo of the Cyberattack would be innocuous, an E-Mail, sent to a new government employee. A Trojan horse, a PDF file requiring a download. The inexperience of the young employee was their folly; the malware would spread, blackening the screen and firing off more E-Mails using generic jargon to infect more devices. From the inside, it would initiate phase one of their plan. The takedown of Dhornaper.gov. Within minutes, the government website would be down, and the red banner of those arrested for pushing the Worldwide Revolution would be raised; it was forbidden to use any Technate symbols, the Chairman of the Defence Forces wanted little connections to this attack.

Following this success, phase two would be put into place, furthering malware infections among government employees. The one breach allowed for the malware to spread like wildfire, infecting other devices, from PC's to printers nothing would be spared. It would spread far, though, like a bull in a daesun shop would be halted rather quickly. The indiscriminate nature of the attacks and the rather obvious display of the attacks, including making screens pure black and spewing out fully inked papers from electronic printers, would stop the spread of malware with common sense. Though the damage would be considerable.

While the nation would be focused on the attacks on the government, the penultimate and final phase would take place, targeting the heart of capitalism. The Dhor Banking system would be struck; the success of the operation would be questionable, as with the open attacks on the government, the banks would be prepared. But nonetheless, even in the greatest walls, cracks lay. With the use of more malware, several million Tomen would be wired out of Dhor banks into Stuipendian shell accounts, and then secretly into the International Proletarian Education Program across the world before being filtered out through legitimate wages and online purchases which lead back to Stuipendia. This would later be transferred into hard cash and eventually used to fund any open Dhor communists that the Technate is aware of through its foreign agents.

[/spoiler]

[i]WBC News Briefing[/i]

Good morning, this is Jonas Bayer, here today with the latest news from Westmore and around the world.

2 men have been arrested for their involvement in a violent incident that occurred in Dalesburg International Airport last night. The men, who were flying a Royal Woods airplane, were believed to be carrying drugs and illegal arms, some of which fell over the city after the airplane was damaged during flight. The men later blew up their aircraft as they attempted to escape authorities, with a violent shootout occurring between them and members of the Federal police, the Air Force and local police. 4 officers have been confirmed dead and 12 have been hospitalised. It is believed that there may also be a third man on the run - authorities are appealing to anyone with information to come forward.

The airport's 02/20 runway remains closed today as a formal investigation into the incident begins - many flights have either been diverted, delayed or outright cancelled as a result.

The Rosenmarkket city of Vysjlla has lost power today after a Wuloosyan and Hochdeutsche-backed attack on the city resulted in its power grid being knocked out. Many people are dead and hospitals in the area are completely overwhelmed and unable to function properly in the wake of the power outage and bombing run on the area. The Westmorian Air Force will continue to send humanitarian aid in the form of clothing, food and generators to support areas affected by this crisis. "We are astonished at the brutality on display from the Hochdeutsche and Wuloosyan armies," a Westmorian soldier on the ground commented. "How can someone do something as cold and inhumane as this, and still go to sleep at night?"

Amid the aid being sent in, there has also been a push for the Air Force to begin accepting asylum seekers from Rosenmarkke via flights coming in and out of the war-torn country; President Lundy hasn't commented on the matter at this time.
